 completed={r["h"] for r in result["harmonics"]}
 for h in HYPOTHESES:

   continue

def numerical_preflight(case,scorer,dense_grid,t,g,w,ys,off):
 """Independently SVD-check the maximum-condition frequency of every fold."""
 record={"scope":"all native CPI, all 8x frequency-grid designs, H=8; Gram eigenvalue prescreen for all designs, original-design SVD for every design outside the unchanged 1e4 normal threshold; maximum and normal-threshold-near probes independently checked by CPU SVD", "probes":[],"design_scan":[]}
 probes=set(float(v) for v in dense_grid[np.linspace(0,len(dense_grid)-1,9,dtype=int)])
 for fold,(train,test) in enumerate(scorer.blocks):
  maximum=(-1.,None)
  near=(float("inf"),None,None);bad_count=0
  for first in range(0,len(dense_grid),1024):
   pp=scorer.tensor(dense_grid[first:first+1024]);x=scorer.design(pp,8)
   a=x[:,train]*torch.sqrt(scorer.w[train])[None,:,None]
   e=torch.linalg.eigvalsh(a.transpose(1,2)@a)
   c=torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(e[:,-1]/e[:,0],min=0))
   bad=(e[:,0]<=0)|(~torch.isfinite(c))|(c>1e4)
   good=~bad
   if good.any():
    indices=torch.nonzero(good).flatten();ki=int(torch.argmax(c[good]).item());ix=indices[ki]
    if 1e4-c[ix].item()<near[0]:near=(float(1e4-c[ix].item()),float(pp[ix].item()),float(c[ix].item()))
   if bad.any():
    s=torch.linalg.svdvals(a[bad]);c[bad]=s[:,0]/s[:,-1];bad_count+=int(bad.sum().item())
    if torch.any(s[:,-1]<=max(a.shape[-2:])*torch.finfo(a.dtype).eps*s[:,0]):raise RuntimeError("preflight explicit rank deficiency")
   i=int(torch.argmax(c).item())
   if c[i].item()>maximum[0]:maximum=(float(c[i].item()),float(pp[i].item()))
  probes.add(maximum[1]);probes.add(near[1]);record["design_scan"].append({"fold":fold,"max_condition":maximum[0],"period_s":maximum[1],"svd_fallback_design_count":bad_count,"largest_normal_condition":near[2],"largest_normal_condition_period_s":near[1]})
  print("PRECHECK scan",case,fold,record["design_scan"][-1],flush=True)
 pp=np.array(sorted(probes));trials=np.arange(len(pp))%len(ys)
 # Grid evaluation checks every channel; paired evaluation checks both pooling rules.
 grid_channels,cond=scorer.grid(pp,8,details=True)
 for j,(p,tr) in enumerate(zip(pp,trials)):
  cpu=MeanCV(t,g,w,ys[tr],off).evaluate(p,8,details=True)
  got=grid_channels[j,tr]
  relative=float(np.max(abs(got-cpu)/np.maximum(1,abs(cpu))))
  assert relative<1e-8,("grid versus CPU SVD",case,p,relative)
  row={"period_s":float(p),"trial_index":int(tr),"cpu_channel_scores":cpu.tolist(),"grid_channel_scores":got.tolist(),"relative_error":relative}
  for pool in ["mean","positive_skill_squared"]:
   expected=cpu.mean() if pool=="mean" else -np.sum(np.maximum(0,1-cpu)**2)
   gotp=float(scorer.paired([p],[tr],8,pool)[0])
   err=float(abs(gotp-expected)/max(1,abs(expected)))
   assert err<1e-8,("paired versus CPU SVD",case,p,pool,err)
   row[pool]={"cpu":float(expected),"gpu":gotp,"relative_error":err}
  record["probes"].append(row)
 # Both newly introduced QR paths must actually run in the difficult 70 m case.

 else:raise AssertionError("rank-deficient design did not fail")
 record["numerics"]=json.loads(json.dumps(scorer.numerics))
 return record

   c[take]=hi[take]-ratio*(hi[take]-lo[take])

    at=x[:,train].transpose(1,2)*self.w[train][None,None,:]
    aa=x[:,train]*torch.sqrt(self.w[train])[None,:,None]
    beta,_,_=self.guarded_solver(aa,at@y[:,train,:],y[:,train,:]*torch.sqrt(self.w[train])[None,:,None],self.tensor(pp),fold)
    residual=y[:,test,:]-x[:,test]@beta
    num+=torch.sum(self.w[test][None,:,None]*residual**2,dim=1)
   channels=num/self.den[torch.as_tensor(tt,device=self.device)]
   pooled=(torch.mean(channels,dim=1) if pool=="mean" else
           -torch.sum(torch.clamp(1-channels,min=0)**2,dim=1))
   out[first:first+len(pp)]=pooled.cpu().numpy()
  return out
 def refine(self,grid,scores,h,iterations=42,pool="mean",topk=None):
  trial=[];idx=[]
  for j in range(scores.shape[1]):
   peaks=signal.find_peaks(-scores[:,j])[0]
   if topk is not None:peaks=peaks[np.argsort(scores[peaks,j])[:topk]]
   inds=np.unique(np.r_[peaks,0,len(grid)-1])
   trial.extend([j]*len(inds));idx.extend(inds)
  trial=np.array(trial);idx=np.array(idx)
  lo=grid[np.maximum(idx-1,0)].copy();hi=grid[np.minimum(idx+1,len(grid)-1)].copy()
  ratio=(np.sqrt(5)-1)/2
  c=hi-ratio*(hi-lo);d=lo+ratio*(hi-lo)
  fc=self.paired(c,trial,h,pool);fd=self.paired(d,trial,h,pool)
  for _ in range(iterations):
   take=fc<fd
   hi[take]=d[take];lo[~take]=c[~take]
   d[take]=c[take];fd[take]=fc[take]
   c[~take]=d[~take];fc[~take]=fd[~take]
   c[take]=hi[take]-ratio*(hi[take]-lo[take])
   d[~take]=lo[~take]+ratio*(hi[~take]-lo[~take])
   pp=np.where(take,c,d)
   ff=self.paired(pp,trial,h,pool)
   fc[take]=ff[take];fd[~take]=ff[~take]
   if (_+1)%10==0:print("refine",h,pool,_+1,"of",iterations,"candidates",len(trial),flush=True)
  p=np.where(fc<fd,c,d);value=np.minimum(fc,fd)
  old=scores[idx,trial];useold=old<value
  p[useold]=grid[idx[useold]];value[useold]=old[useold]
  winners=[]
  for j in range(scores.shape[1]):
   mask=np.flatnonzero(trial==j);i=mask[np.argmin(value[mask])]
   winners.append({"trial_index":j,"h":h,"pool":pool,"period_s":float(p[i]),"score":float(value[i]),
                   "local_minima_count":len(mask)})
  return winners

def run(case,device,snrs,limit,refine_mode="all"):

  pooled={"mean":channels.mean(axis=2),"positive_skill_squared":-np.sum(np.maximum(0,1-channels)**2,axis=2)}
  allrows={};winnerchecks=[]
  for pool,values in pooled.items():

"""Paired cache evaluation under an explicitly bounded numerical protocol.

All frequencies in 4x and 8x original grids. At each H/trial, refine the three
best local grid minima plus both endpoints; retain original grid scores.
This is NOT continuous global certification or refinement of every local
minimum. No period-truth neighborhood is used. Identical H and pooling rules
are frozen before noise results.
"""
from noise_mean_cv import *

def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def numerical_preflight(case,scorer,dense_grid,t,g,w,ys,off):
 """Independently SVD-check the maximum-condition frequency of every fold."""
 record={"scope":"all native CPI, all 8x frequency-grid designs, H=8; Gram eigenvalue prescreen for all designs, original-design SVD outside tightened 1e3 normal threshold; maximum and normal-threshold-near probes independently checked by CPU SVD", "probes":[],"design_scan":[]}
 probes=set(float(v) for v in dense_grid[np.linspace(0,len(dense_grid)-1,9,dtype=int)])
 for fold,(train,test) in enumerate(scorer.blocks):
  maximum=(-1.,None)
  near=(float("inf"),None,None);bad_count=0
  for first in range(0,len(dense_grid),1024):
   pp=scorer.tensor(dense_grid[first:first+1024]);x=scorer.design(pp,8)
   a=x[:,train]*torch.sqrt(scorer.w[train])[None,:,None]
   e=torch.linalg.eigvalsh(a.transpose(1,2)@a)
   c=torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(e[:,-1]/e[:,0],min=0))
   bad=(e[:,0]<=0)|(~torch.isfinite(c))|(c>1e3)
   good=~bad
   if good.any():
    indices=torch.nonzero(good).flatten();ki=int(torch.argmax(c[good]).item());ix=indices[ki]
    if 1e3-c[ix].item()<near[0]:near=(float(1e3-c[ix].item()),float(pp[ix].item()),float(c[ix].item()))
   if bad.any():
    s=torch.linalg.svdvals(a[bad]);c[bad]=s[:,0]/s[:,-1];bad_count+=int(bad.sum().item())
    if torch.any(s[:,-1]<=max(a.shape[-2:])*torch.finfo(a.dtype).eps*s[:,0]):raise RuntimeError("preflight explicit rank deficiency")
   i=int(torch.argmax(c).item())
   if c[i].item()>maximum[0]:maximum=(float(c[i].item()),float(pp[i].item()))
  probes.add(maximum[1]);probes.add(near[1]);record["design_scan"].append({"fold":fold,"max_condition":maximum[0],"period_s":maximum[1],"svd_fallback_design_count":bad_count,"largest_normal_condition":near[2],"largest_normal_condition_period_s":near[1]})
  print("PRECHECK scan",case,fold,record["design_scan"][-1],flush=True)
 pp=np.array(sorted(probes));trials=np.arange(len(pp))%len(ys)
 # Grid evaluation checks every channel; paired evaluation checks both pooling rules.
 grid_channels,cond=scorer.grid(pp,8,details=True)
 cpu_probes=[MeanCV(t,g,w,ys[tr],off).evaluate(p,8,details=True) for p,tr in zip(pp,trials)]
 feasible_mean=min(float(ch.mean()) for ch in cpu_probes)
 for j,(p,tr) in enumerate(zip(pp,trials)):
  cpu=cpu_probes[j]
  got=grid_channels[j,tr]
  relative=float(np.max(abs(got-cpu)/np.maximum(1,abs(cpu))))
  rejected_by_margin=bool(np.all(cpu>1e5) and np.all(got>1e5) and feasible_mean<2)
  tolerance=1e-7 if rejected_by_margin else 1e-8
  assert relative<tolerance,("grid versus CPU SVD",case,p,relative)
  row={"period_s":float(p),"trial_index":int(tr),"cpu_channel_scores":cpu.tolist(),"grid_channel_scores":got.tolist(),"relative_error":relative,"relative_tolerance":tolerance,"extreme_negative_control":rejected_by_margin,"reference_feasible_mean_cv":feasible_mean}
  for pool in ["mean","positive_skill_squared"]:
   expected=cpu.mean() if pool=="mean" else -np.sum(np.maximum(0,1-cpu)**2)
   gotp=float(scorer.paired([p],[tr],8,pool)[0])
   err=float(abs(gotp-expected)/max(1,abs(expected)))
   assert err<tolerance,("paired versus CPU SVD",case,p,pool,err)
   if rejected_by_margin and pool!="mean":assert gotp==expected==0
   row[pool]={"cpu":float(expected),"gpu":gotp,"relative_error":err}
  record["probes"].append(row)
 # Both newly introduced QR paths must actually run in the difficult 70 m case.
 if case=="70m":assert scorer.numerics["qr_designs"]>0
 a=scorer.tensor(np.ones((1,10,2)));rhs=scorer.tensor(np.ones((1,2,1)))
 try:scorer.guarded_solver(a,rhs,scorer.tensor(np.ones((10,1))),scorer.tensor([1.]),0)
 except RuntimeError as exc:record["rank_deficiency_explicit_failure"]=str(exc)
 else:raise AssertionError("rank-deficient design did not fail")
 record["numerics"]=json.loads(json.dumps(scorer.numerics))
 return record

"""Frozen mean-CV rule on old IQ-noise feature caches.

Full original frequency grid; every local grid minimum and endpoint is refined
by batched golden-section iterations. GPU float64 normal solves are checked
against the CPU SVD evaluator before search and at selected winners. No echoes
or noise are generated. The original 100 paired realizations are reused.
"""
import os
for k in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS","OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS","MKL_NUM_THREADS"):os.environ[k]="1"
import sys,json,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import numpy as np
from scipy import signal
import torch
from verify_mean_cv import MeanCV,CASES,ROOT,read_case,HYPOTHESES
OUT=Path(__file__).parent
torch.set_num_threads(1)

class BatchMeanCV:
 def __init__(self,t,g,w,ys,off,device="cpu",batch=1024,pair_batch=4096):
  self.device=torch.device(device);self.batch=batch;self.pair_batch=pair_batch
  self.np_t=t;self.np_g=g;self.np_w=w;self.np_off=off
  keys=sorted(np.unique(g),key=lambda k:np.mean(t[g==k]))
  ww=w.copy()
  for key in keys:ww[g==key]/=np.sum(ww[g==key])
  labels=np.array([{k:i%5 for i,k in enumerate(keys)}[k] for k in g])
  y=ys/np.max(abs(ys),axis=1,keepdims=True)
  y-=np.sum(y*ww[None,:,None],axis=1,keepdims=True)/sum(ww)
  y/=np.sqrt(np.sum(y*y*ww[None,:,None],axis=1,keepdims=True)/sum(ww))
  self.np_y=y
  self.y=self.tensor(y)
  self.t=self.tensor(t);self.off=self.tensor(off);self.w=self.tensor(ww)
  self.blocks=[]
  den=np.zeros((len(ys),ys.shape[-1]))
  for k in range(5):
   train=labels!=k;test=~train
   center=np.average(y[:,train,:],weights=ww[train],axis=1)
   den+=np.sum(ww[None,test,None]*(y[:,test,:]-center[:,None,:])**2,axis=1)
   self.blocks.append((torch.as_tensor(train,device=device),torch.as_tensor(test,device=device)))
  self.den=self.tensor(den)
  self.numerics={"normal_designs":0,"qr_designs":0,"max_normal_condition":0.,"max_qr_condition":0.,"qr_examples":[]}
 def tensor(self,a):return torch.as_tensor(a,dtype=torch.float64,device=self.device)
 def guarded_solver(self,a,rhs,weighted_y=None,periods=None,fold=None):
  """Normal solves only at condition <= 1e3; QR otherwise, rank checked by SVD.

  rhs is A'Y. QR fallback requires weighted_y so it never inverts A'A.
  Nonfinite/rank-deficient designs explicitly fail the run, never get dropped.
  """
  gram=a.transpose(1,2)@a
  eig=torch.linalg.eigvalsh(gram)
  conditions=torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(eig[:,-1]/eig[:,0],min=0))
  bad=(eig[:,0]<=0)|(~torch.isfinite(conditions))|(conditions>1e3)
  good=~bad
  beta=torch.empty_like(rhs)
  if good.any():
   if weighted_y is not None and weighted_y.ndim==2:
    eye=torch.eye(gram.shape[-1],dtype=gram.dtype,device=gram.device).expand(int(good.sum().item()),-1,-1)
    beta[good]=torch.linalg.solve(gram[good],eye)@rhs[good]
   else:beta[good]=torch.linalg.solve(gram[good],rhs[good])
   self.numerics["normal_designs"]+=int(good.sum().item())
   self.numerics["max_normal_condition"]=max(self.numerics["max_normal_condition"],float(conditions[good].max().item()))
  if bad.any():
   if weighted_y is None:raise RuntimeError("QR fallback missing original weighted observations")
   aa=a[bad]
   singular=torch.linalg.svdvals(aa)
   rank_tol=max(aa.shape[-2:])*torch.finfo(aa.dtype).eps*singular[:,0]
   if torch.any(singular[:,-1]<=rank_tol) or not torch.isfinite(singular).all():
    raise RuntimeError(f"explicit numerical failure: rank-deficient/nonfinite design; fold={fold}; periods={periods[bad].detach().cpu().tolist() if periods is not None else None}")
   qc=singular[:,0]/singular[:,-1]
   q,r=torch.linalg.qr(aa,mode="reduced")
   yy=weighted_y if weighted_y.ndim==2 else weighted_y[bad]
   beta[bad]=torch.linalg.solve_triangular(r,q.transpose(1,2)@yy,upper=True)
   self.numerics["qr_designs"]+=int(bad.sum().item())
   self.numerics["max_qr_condition"]=max(self.numerics["max_qr_condition"],float(qc.max().item()))
   if len(self.numerics["qr_examples"])<12:
    local=int(torch.argmax(qc).item());indices=torch.flatnonzero(bad) if hasattr(torch,"flatnonzero") else torch.nonzero(bad).flatten()
    self.numerics["qr_examples"].append({"fold":fold,"condition":float(qc[local].item()),"period_s":float(periods[indices[local]].item()) if periods is not None else None})
  if not torch.isfinite(beta).all():raise RuntimeError("explicit numerical failure: nonfinite least-squares coefficients")
  return beta,bad,max(float(conditions[good].max().item()) if good.any() else 0.,float(qc.max().item()) if bad.any() else 0.)
 def design(self,p,h):
  ph=2*np.pi*self.t[None,:]/p[:,None]+self.off[None,:]
  return torch.stack([torch.ones_like(ph)]+[f(j*ph) for j in range(1,h+1) for f in [torch.cos,torch.sin]],dim=2)
 def grid(self,grid,h,details=False):
  out=np.empty((len(grid),len(self.y),self.y.shape[-1]))
  maxcond=0.
  for first in range(0,len(grid),self.batch):
   p=self.tensor(grid[first:first+self.batch]); x=self.design(p,h)
   num=torch.zeros((len(p),len(self.y),self.y.shape[-1]),dtype=torch.float64,device=self.device)
   for fold,(train,test) in enumerate(self.blocks):
    a=x[:,train]*torch.sqrt(self.w[train])[None,:,None]
    # Guard all grid designs, so no ill-conditioned normal solve is silent.
    at=x[:,train].transpose(1,2)*self.w[train][None,None,:]
    flat=self.y[:,train,:].permute(1,0,2).reshape(train.sum().item(),-1)
    rhs=(at.reshape(-1,train.sum().item())@flat).reshape(len(p),x.shape[-1],-1)
    weighted_y=flat*torch.sqrt(self.w[train])[:,None]
    solved,bad,cond=self.guarded_solver(a,rhs,weighted_y,p,fold)
    maxcond=max(maxcond,cond)
    beta=solved.reshape(len(p),x.shape[-1],len(self.y),-1)
    tx=x[:,test]
    tc=tx.transpose(1,2)*self.w[test][None,None,:]
    tflat=self.y[:,test,:].permute(1,0,2).reshape(test.sum().item(),-1)
    xy=(tc.reshape(-1,test.sum().item())@tflat).reshape_as(beta)
    testgram=tc@tx
    yy=torch.sum(self.y[:,test,:]**2*self.w[test][None,:,None],dim=1)
    increment=yy[None]-2*torch.sum(beta*xy,dim=1)+torch.einsum("girc,gij,gjrc->grc",beta,testgram,beta)
    if bad.any():
     prediction=torch.einsum("gni,girc->grnc",tx[bad],beta[bad])
     residual=self.y[None,:,test,:]-prediction
     increment[bad]=torch.sum(residual**2*self.w[test][None,None,:,None],dim=2)
    num+=increment
   out[first:first+len(p)]=(num/self.den[None]).cpu().numpy()
  return (out if details else out.mean(axis=2)),maxcond
 def paired(self,periods,trials,h,pool="mean"):
  periods=np.asarray(periods,float);trials=np.asarray(trials,int)
  out=np.empty(len(periods))
  for first in range(0,len(periods),self.pair_batch):
   pp=periods[first:first+self.pair_batch];tt=trials[first:first+self.pair_batch]
   x=self.design(self.tensor(pp),h); y=self.y[torch.as_tensor(tt,device=self.device)]
   num=torch.zeros((len(pp),y.shape[-1]),dtype=torch.float64,device=self.device)
   for fold,(train,test) in enumerate(self.blocks):
    at=x[:,train].transpose(1,2)*self.w[train][None,None,:]
    aa=x[:,train]*torch.sqrt(self.w[train])[None,:,None]
    beta,_,_=self.guarded_solver(aa,at@y[:,train,:],y[:,train,:]*torch.sqrt(self.w[train])[None,:,None],self.tensor(pp),fold)
    residual=y[:,test,:]-x[:,test]@beta
    num+=torch.sum(self.w[test][None,:,None]*residual**2,dim=1)
   channels=num/self.den[torch.as_tensor(tt,device=self.device)]
   pooled=(torch.mean(channels,dim=1) if pool=="mean" else
           -torch.sum(torch.clamp(1-channels,min=0)**2,dim=1))
   out[first:first+len(pp)]=pooled.cpu().numpy()
  return out
 def refine(self,grid,scores,h,iterations=42,pool="mean",topk=None):
  trial=[];idx=[]
  for j in range(scores.shape[1]):
   peaks=signal.find_peaks(-scores[:,j])[0]
   if topk is not None:peaks=peaks[np.argsort(scores[peaks,j])[:topk]]
   inds=np.unique(np.r_[peaks,0,len(grid)-1])
   trial.extend([j]*len(inds));idx.extend(inds)
  trial=np.array(trial);idx=np.array(idx)
  lo=grid[np.maximum(idx-1,0)].copy();hi=grid[np.minimum(idx+1,len(grid)-1)].copy()
  ratio=(np.sqrt(5)-1)/2
  c=hi-ratio*(hi-lo);d=lo+ratio*(hi-lo)
  fc=self.paired(c,trial,h,pool);fd=self.paired(d,trial,h,pool)
  for _ in range(iterations):
   take=fc<fd
   hi[take]=d[take];lo[~take]=c[~take]
   d[take]=c[take];fd[take]=fc[take]
   c[~take]=d[~take];fc[~take]=fd[~take]
   c[take]=hi[take]-ratio*(hi[take]-lo[take])
   d[~take]=lo[~take]+ratio*(hi[~take]-lo[~take])
   pp=np.where(take,c,d)
   ff=self.paired(pp,trial,h,pool)
   fc[take]=ff[take];fd[~take]=ff[~take]
   if (_+1)%10==0:print("refine",h,pool,_+1,"of",iterations,"candidates",len(trial),flush=True)
  p=np.where(fc<fd,c,d);value=np.minimum(fc,fd)
  old=scores[idx,trial];useold=old<value
  p[useold]=grid[idx[useold]];value[useold]=old[useold]
  winners=[]
  for j in range(scores.shape[1]):
   mask=np.flatnonzero(trial==j);i=mask[np.argmin(value[mask])]
   winners.append({"trial_index":j,"h":h,"pool":pool,"period_s":float(p[i]),"score":float(value[i]),
                   "local_minima_count":len(mask)})
  return winners

def run(case,device,snrs,limit,refine_mode="all"):
 t,g,w,_,off,cfg=read_case(case,aggregate=False)
 off=off if cfg["los_phase_compensation"] else np.zeros_like(t)
 cache=ROOT/CASES[case][1]
 design=np.load(cache/"design.npz")
 data=np.load(cache/"features.npy",mmap_mode="r")
 selected=np.array([int(np.flatnonzero(design["snr_db"]==v)[0]) for v in snrs])
 ys=np.asarray(data[:limit,selected]).transpose(1,0,2,3).reshape(-1,len(t),5)
 identities=[{"snr_db":s,"replicate":i} for s in snrs for i in range(min(limit,len(data)))]
 grid=np.sort(1/np.linspace(1/cfg["period_max_s"],1/cfg["period_min_s"],cfg["period_grid_size"]))
 scorer=BatchMeanCV(t,g,w,ys,off,device=device)
 result={"case":case,"utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"rule":"native500 same frozen mean-CV rule",
         "snrs":snrs,"replicates":limit,"device":device,"identities":identities,"harmonics":[],
         "refine_mode":refine_mode,
         "script_sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
 output_path=OUT/f"{case}_noise_{refine_mode}.json"
 # Period probes span full configured domain and do not reference truth.
 probes=grid[np.array([1,len(grid)//3,2*len(grid)//3,len(grid)-2])]
 validations=[]
 for h in HYPOTHESES:
  start=time.perf_counter()
  val=scorer.paired(probes,np.arange(4)%len(ys),h)
  refs=np.array([MeanCV(t,g,w,ys[j%len(ys)],off).evaluate(p,h) for j,p in enumerate(probes)])
  diff=float(np.max(abs(val-refs)))
  assert diff<1e-9,(h,diff)
  channels,condition=scorer.grid(grid,h,details=True)
  assert np.all(np.isfinite(channels))
  pooled={"mean":channels.mean(axis=2),"positive_skill_squared":-np.sum(np.maximum(0,1-channels)**2,axis=2)}
  allrows={};winnerchecks=[]
  for pool,values in pooled.items():
   if refine_mode=="all":
    rows=scorer.refine(grid,values,h,pool=pool)
   else:
    best_indices=np.argmin(values,axis=0)
    rows=[{"trial_index":j,"h":h,"pool":pool,"period_s":float(grid[i]),"score":float(values[i,j]),
           "grid_index":int(i),"local_minima_count":int(len(signal.find_peaks(-values[:,j])[0])+2)}
          for j,i in enumerate(best_indices)]
    np.save(OUT/f"{case}_{pool}_H{h}_grid.npy",values)
   allrows[pool]=rows
   for j in sorted(set([0,len(ys)//2,len(ys)-1])):
    ev=MeanCV(t,g,w,ys[j],off)
    cpuchannels=ev.evaluate(rows[j]["period_s"],h,details=True)
    expected=(cpuchannels.mean() if pool=="mean" else -np.sum(np.maximum(0,1-cpuchannels)**2))
    diffwin=abs(expected-rows[j]["score"])
    assert diffwin<1e-9,(h,j,diffwin)
    winnerchecks.append({"trial":j,"pool":pool,"absolute_score_difference":float(diffwin)})
   print(case,"H",h,"pool",pool,"elapsed",time.perf_counter()-start,flush=True)
  record={"h":h,"max_grid_design_condition":condition,"precheck_max_error":diff,
          "winner_cpu_checks":winnerchecks,"winners":allrows,"wall_seconds":time.perf_counter()-start}
  result["harmonics"].append(record)
  output_path.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
  print(case,"H",h,"seconds",record["wall_seconds"],flush=True)
 result["selected"]={pool:[min([r["winners"][pool][i] for r in result["harmonics"]],key=lambda v:(v["score"],v["h"]))
                     for i in range(len(ys))] for pool in pooled}
 # Truth only used below, after all period/H winners have been selected.
 historic=json.loads((cache/"result.json").read_text())
 truth=historic["truth_repetition_s"]
 result["reporting_truth_s"]=truth
 result["summary"]=[]
 for pool,poolrows in result["selected"].items():
  for snr in snrs:
   selected_rows=[v for v,idn in zip(poolrows,identities) if idn["snr_db"]==snr]
   p=np.array([r["period_s"] for r in selected_rows]);e=(p/truth-1)*100
   hs=np.array([r["h"] for r in selected_rows])
   result["summary"].append({"pool":pool,"snr_db":snr,"mean_bias_s":float(np.mean(p-truth)),
    "rmse_percent":float(np.sqrt(np.mean(e*e))),"median_abs_percent":float(np.median(abs(e))),
    "within_0p1_percent":int(np.sum(abs(e)<=.1)),"within_1_percent":int(np.sum(abs(e)<=1)),
     "h_counts":{str(h):int(np.sum(hs==h)) for h in HYPOTHESES}})
 output_path.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
 print("SUMMARY",case,json.dumps(result["summary"]),flush=True)

if __name__=="__main__":
 import argparse

 parser.add_argument("--device",default="cpu")

"""Additional declared exploratory family: additive trends and CV pooling.
The entire output, including failures, is retained; truth is absent.
"""
import os
for k in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS","OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS","MKL_NUM_THREADS"):os.environ[k]="1"
import json,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy import signal,optimize
from search_features import read_case,NAMES
OUT=Path(__file__).parent
for case in ["70m","400m"]:
 t,g,w,y,off,cfg=read_case(case)
 grid=np.sort(1/np.linspace(1/cfg["period_max_s"],1/cfg["period_min_s"],cfg["period_grid_size"]))
 fold=np.arange(len(t))%5
 u=(t-np.mean(t))/np.ptp(t)
 den=sum(np.sum((y[fold==k]-np.mean(y[fold!=k],axis=0))**2,axis=0) for k in range(5))
 records=[]
 for degree in [0,1,2]:
  for h in [1,2,4,8]:
   start=time.perf_counter()
   def evaluate(p):
    ph=2*np.pi*t/p+(off if case=="400m" else 0)
    x=np.column_stack([u**d for d in range(degree+1)]+[f(j*ph) for j in range(1,h+1) for f in [np.cos,np.sin]])
    num=np.zeros(5)
    for k in range(5):
     train=fold!=k;test=~train
     b=np.linalg.lstsq(x[train],y[train],rcond=None)[0]
     num+=np.sum((y[test]-x[test]@b)**2,axis=0)
    cv=num/den
    skill=np.maximum(0,1-cv)
    return np.r_[cv.mean(),np.log(cv).mean(),-np.sum(skill**2),-np.sum(skill**3)]
   labels=["cv_mean","cv_log_mean","cv_positive_skill_squared","cv_positive_skill_cubed"]
   scores=np.array([evaluate(p) for p in grid])
   record={"case":case,"degree":degree,"h":h,"selected":{}}
   for j,label in enumerate(labels):
    peaks=np.unique(np.r_[signal.find_peaks(-scores[:,j])[0],0,len(grid)-1])
    order=sorted(peaks,key=lambda k:scores[k,j])
    candidates=[]
    for i in order[:10]:
     lo,hi=grid[max(i-1,0)],grid[min(i+1,len(grid)-1)]
     res=optimize.minimize_scalar(lambda p:evaluate(p)[j],bounds=(lo,hi),method="bounded",options={"xatol":1e-7})
     p=float(res.x) if res.fun<scores[i,j] else float(grid[i])
     candidates.append({"period_s":p,"score":float(evaluate(p)[j])})
    candidates.sort(key=lambda c:c["score"])
    record["selected"][label]=candidates[:5]
   record["wall_seconds"]=time.perf_counter()-start
   records.append(record)
   (OUT/f"{case}_robust_probe.json").write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
   print(case,degree,h,json.dumps({k:v[0] for k,v in record["selected"].items()}),flush=True)

"""Exploratory full-domain fits on frozen features, never generating echoes.

Choice space declared before results: H=1,2,4,8; LOS off/on with supplied
105/-66 degree pole; Run means; shared standardized SSE and whole-Run 5-fold CV.
All outcomes retained. Truth appears only in a final reporting pass.
"""
import os
for key in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS"):
    os.environ[key] = "1"
import sys,json,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import numpy as np
from scipy import optimize,signal
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from inversion.src.period_enhancements import effective_look_phase
OUT=Path(__file__).parent
CASES={
 "70m":("runs/ev5_snr_20261016_70m","tmp/receiver_snr_ev5_70m_20261016"),
 "400m":("runs/ev5_snr_longcpi_20261016_400m","tmp/receiver_snr_ev5_400m_20261016"),
}
NAMES=["power","doppler_centroid","doppler_width","range_centroid","range_width"]
def read_case(name,aggregate=True):
    run,cache=CASES[name]
    a=np.load(ROOT/run/"inversion/period_observables.npz")
    cfg=json.loads(str(a["metadata_json"]))["inversion_config"]
    y=np.load(ROOT/cache/"clean_features.npy")
    t=a["time_elapsed_s"];g=a["run_id"];w=a["effective_sample_count"]
    echo=np.load(ROOT/run/"echo/echo.npz")
    obj=SimpleNamespace(**{k:echo[k] for k in ["scatter_elapsed_s","tx_los_icrs","rx_los_icrs"]})
    off=effective_look_phase(obj,t,{"spin_axis_ra_deg":105.,"spin_axis_dec_deg":-66.,
                                "phase_period_convention":"full_rotation"})
    if aggregate:
        groups=np.unique(g)
        y=np.array([np.average(y[g==v],axis=0,weights=w[g==v]) for v in groups])
        tt=np.array([np.average(t[g==v],weights=w[g==v]) for v in groups])
        oo=np.array([np.average(off[g==v],weights=w[g==v]) for v in groups])
        t,off,g,w=tt,oo,groups,np.ones(len(groups))
    t=t-t.min()
    y=y/np.max(abs(y),axis=0)
    y-=np.average(y,weights=w,axis=0)
    y/=np.sqrt(np.average(y*y,weights=w,axis=0))
    return t,g,w,y,off,cfg

def run(name):
    t,g,w,y,off,cfg=read_case(name)
    grid=np.sort(1/np.linspace(1/cfg["period_max_s"],1/cfg["period_min_s"],cfg["period_grid_size"]))
    folds=np.arange(len(t))%5

"""Frozen candidate rule verification on all 500 original CPIs.

RULE (frozen before these results): preserve production LOS flag, five feature
channels, shared constant plus H harmonic pairs, H in {1,2,4,8}; minimize the
arithmetic mean of the five normalized held-out squared errors. Each Run has
equal total weight. All local grid minima and both boundaries refined.
Select H by the same CV score, never by period truth. Also report full-data SSE
refinement in the CV winner's local basin as a distinct diagnostic.
"""
import os
for k in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS","OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS","MKL_NUM_THREADS"):
    os.environ[k]="1"
import json,time,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import numpy as np
from scipy import optimize,signal
from search_features import CASES,ROOT,read_case
OUT=Path(__file__).parent
HYPOTHESES=[1,2,4,8]

class MeanCV:
    def __init__(self,t,g,w,y,off):
        self.t=np.asarray(t,float)
        self.off=np.asarray(off,float)
        self.w=w.copy()
        keys=sorted(np.unique(g),key=lambda k:np.mean(t[g==k]))
        for k in keys:self.w[g==k]/=np.sum(self.w[g==k])
        self.root=np.sqrt(self.w)
        self.y=y.copy()/np.max(abs(y),axis=0)
        self.y-=np.average(self.y,weights=self.w,axis=0)
        self.y/=np.sqrt(np.average(self.y*self.y,weights=self.w,axis=0))
        labels=np.array([{k:i%5 for i,k in enumerate(keys)}[k] for k in g])
        self.blocks=[]
        self.den=np.zeros(y.shape[1])
        for k in range(5):
            train=labels!=k;test=~train
            center=np.average(self.y[train],weights=self.w[train],axis=0)
            self.den+=np.sum(self.w[test,None]*(self.y[test]-center)**2,axis=0)
            self.blocks.append((train,test))
        self.fit_den=np.sum(self.w[:,None]*self.y**2,axis=0)

    def design(self,p,h):
        ph=2*np.pi*self.t/p+self.off
        return np.column_stack([np.ones(len(ph))]+[f(j*ph) for j in range(1,h+1)
                                                        for f in [np.cos,np.sin]])
    def evaluate(self,p,h,kind="cv",details=False):
        x=self.design(p,h)
        num=np.zeros(self.y.shape[1])
        blocks=self.blocks if kind=="cv" else [(np.ones(len(x),bool),np.ones(len(x),bool))]
        for train,test in blocks:
            b,_,rank,_=np.linalg.lstsq(x[train]*self.root[train,None],
                                     self.y[train]*self.root[train,None],rcond=None)
            if rank<x.shape[1]:return np.inf
            num+=np.sum(self.w[test,None]*(self.y[test]-x[test]@b)**2,axis=0)
        errors=num/(self.den if kind=="cv" else self.fit_den)
        return errors if details else float(errors.mean())

def search(evaluator,grid,h,kind="cv"):
    vals=np.array([evaluator.evaluate(p,h,kind) for p in grid])
    indices=np.unique(np.r_[signal.find_peaks(-vals)[0],0,len(grid)-1])
    candidates=[]
    for i in indices:
        p=float(grid[i]); value=float(vals[i])
        lo,hi=grid[max(0,i-1)],grid[min(len(grid)-1,i+1)]
        fit=optimize.minimize_scalar(lambda p:evaluator.evaluate(p,h,kind),
                                    bounds=(lo,hi),method="bounded",options={"xatol":1e-7})
        if fit.success and fit.fun<value:p,value=float(fit.x),float(fit.fun)
        candidates.append({"period_s":p,"score":value,"grid_index":int(i),
                           "channel_errors":evaluator.evaluate(p,h,kind,True).tolist()})
    candidates.sort(key=lambda c:(c["score"],c["period_s"]))
    return {"h":h,"local_minima_with_endpoints":len(indices),"candidates":candidates}

def run(case):
    t,g,w,y,off,cfg=read_case(case,aggregate=False)
    off=off if cfg["los_phase_compensation"] else np.zeros_like(t)
    ev=MeanCV(t,g,w,y,off)
    grid=np.sort(1/np.linspace(1/cfg["period_max_s"],1/cfg["period_min_s"],cfg["period_grid_size"]))
    result={"case":case,"utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"n_cpi":len(t),
            "n_runs":len(np.unique(g)),"los":cfg["los_phase_compensation"],
            "rule":"mean normalized whole-Run CV; choose H from 1,2,4,8 by same score; full grid and all minima refinement",
            "harmonics":[]}
    for h in HYPOTHESES:
        start=time.perf_counter()
        record=search(ev,grid,h)
        record["wall_seconds"]=time.perf_counter()-start
        result["harmonics"].append(record)
        (OUT/f"{case}_native500_verified.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
        print(case,h,json.dumps(record["candidates"][0]),"local_minima",record["local_minima_with_endpoints"],flush=True)
    winner=min(result["harmonics"],key=lambda r:(r["candidates"][0]["score"],r["h"]))
    best=winner["candidates"][0]; i=best["grid_index"];h=winner["h"]
    lo,hi=grid[max(i-2,0)],grid[min(i+2,len(grid)-1)]
    fit=optimize.minimize_scalar(lambda p:ev.evaluate(p,h,"fit"),bounds=(lo,hi),
                                method="bounded",options={"xatol":1e-7})
    result["selected"]={"h":h,**best}
    result["diagnostic_full_data_sse_local_refinement"]={"period_s":float(fit.x),"score":float(fit.fun),
                                                       "bounds_s":[float(lo),float(hi)]}
    result["script_sha256"]=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    result["input_hashes"]={}
    for relative in [CASES[case][0]+"/inversion/period_observables.npz",
                     CASES[case][1]+"/design.npz",CASES[case][1]+"/clean_features.npy"]:
        result["input_hashes"][relative]=hashlib.sha256((ROOT/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    (OUT/f"{case}_native500_verified.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
    print("SELECTED",case,json.dumps(result["selected"]),flush=True)

if __name__=="__main__":
    for case in sys.argv[1:] or list(CASES):run(case)

"""Read existing compensated IQ and export fixed full-support power observations.

This is a research extraction, not new echo generation or production modification.
No shape, period truth, or initial phase is used by extraction.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import sys
import time
import json
import hashlib
from datetime import datetime, timezone

for name in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS"):
    os.environ[name] = "1"
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
import numpy as np
from scipy import signal
from scipy import fft
from inversion.src.dataset import load_echo
from inversion.src.inversion import _echo_pulse_chunk, prepare_chirp_pulse_profiles, _global_delay_grid
from inversion.src.radar_signal import align_profiles_to_common_delay, chirp_reference_sample_count


def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(8 * 1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def one_case(case):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    job = {"70m": "ev5_snr_20261016_70m",
           "400m": "ev5_snr_longcpi_20261016_400m"}[case]
    source = ROOT / "runs" / job / "echo" / "echo.npz"
    cache = source.parent / "processing_cache" / "observations.npz"
    src_before = (source.stat().st_size, source.stat().st_mtime_ns)
    obs = np.load(cache)
    manifest = json.loads(obs["manifest"].item())
    policy = manifest["key"]["policy"]
    config = {k: v for k, v in policy.items() if k != "compute_execution"}
    config["compute_device"] = "cpu"
    echo = load_echo(source, mapped_directory=OUT / (case + "_mapped"), load_clean=False)
    assert echo.metadata["snr_db"] is None
    assert echo.metadata["echo_output_reference"] == "centroid_compensated"
    assert not np.any(echo.signal_echo_overlap)
    assert not np.any(echo.window_overlap)
    assert np.all(echo.valid)
    fast = np.asarray(echo.fast_time_s)
    dt = float(np.median(np.diff(fast)))
    lag = chirp_reference_sample_count(echo.metadata["pulse_width_s"], dt) - 1
    full_fast = fast[0] + (np.arange(len(fast) + lag) - lag) * dt
    offsets = np.asarray(echo.row_fast_time_offset_s)
    grid = _global_delay_grid(full_fast, offsets, preserve_support=True)
    axis = grid[0]
    windows = obs["cpi_windows"]
    count = int(windows[0, 1] - windows[0, 0])
    assert np.all(np.diff(windows, axis=1)[:, 0] == count)
    hann = signal.get_window("hann", count, fftbins=True)
    weights = hann * hann
    norm = float(count * weights.sum())
    # Bins fixed from acquisition extent; both full-support tails retained.
    extent_delay = float(echo.metadata["planned_target_extent_path_m"]) / 299792458.0
    inner_edges = np.linspace(-extent_delay, extent_delay, 257)
    labels = np.searchsorted(inner_edges, axis, side="right")
    labels = np.clip(labels, 0, 257)
    changes = np.flatnonzero(np.diff(labels)) + 1
    split = np.r_[0, changes]
    label_starts = labels[split]
    pulse_binned = np.empty((len(echo.iq), 258))
    profiles = np.empty((len(windows), len(axis)))
    binned = np.empty((len(windows), 258))
    cpi_runs = np.empty(len(windows), dtype=np.int64)
    cpi_times = np.empty(len(windows))
    cpi_weighted_times = np.empty(len(windows))
    max_bin_sum_relative = 0.0
    groups = np.unique(echo.run_id)
    print(case, "pulse shape", echo.iq.shape, "full axis", len(axis), "CPI", len(windows), flush=True)
    for iteration, run in enumerate(groups):
        rows = np.flatnonzero(echo.run_id == run)
        begin, end = int(rows[0]), int(rows[-1] + 1)
        assert np.array_equal(rows, np.arange(begin, end))
        chunk = _echo_pulse_chunk(echo, begin, end, len(echo.iq))
        native = prepare_chirp_pulse_profiles(chunk, config, pulse_features_only=True)
        _, aligned = align_profiles_to_common_delay(
            native["full_compressed"], native["full_delay_axes"],
            preserve_support=True, common_grid=grid, method="fourier")
        power = np.abs(aligned) ** 2
        bins = np.zeros((len(rows), 258))
        bins[:, label_starts] = np.add.reduceat(power, split, axis=1)
        pulse_binned[rows] = bins
        max_bin_sum_relative = max(max_bin_sum_relative, float(np.max(
            np.abs(bins.sum(axis=1) - power.sum(axis=1)) / power.sum(axis=1))))
        selected = np.flatnonzero((windows[:, 0] >= begin) & (windows[:, 1] <= end))
        for index in selected:
            lo, hi = windows[index] - begin
            times = native["processing_times"][lo:hi]
            assert np.allclose(np.diff(times), np.median(np.diff(times)), rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-9)
            # Exactly normalized production full-range Parseval marginal.
            profiles[index] = weights @ power[lo:hi] / weights.sum()
            binned[index] = weights @ bins[lo:hi] / weights.sum()
            cpi_runs[index] = run
            cpi_times[index] = np.mean(times)
            cpi_weighted_times[index] = weights @ times / weights.sum()
        if iteration % 10 == 0 or iteration == len(groups) - 1:
            print(case, iteration + 1, "/", len(groups), "elapsed_s", round(time.perf_counter() - start, 2), flush=True)
        del chunk, native, aligned, power, bins
    production_total = profiles.sum(axis=1) * norm
    production_centroid = profiles @ axis / profiles.sum(axis=1)
    old_total = obs["features__total_power"]
    old_centroid = obs["features__range_centroid_s"]
    total_relative = float(np.max(np.abs(production_total - old_total) / old_total))
    centroid_absolute = float(np.max(np.abs(production_centroid - old_centroid)))
    assert np.allclose(cpi_times, obs["features__times_s"], rtol=0, atol=1e-9)
    assert max_bin_sum_relative < 3e-15
    assert total_relative < 2e-5, total_relative  # Old cached GPU/float precision allowed.
    assert centroid_absolute < dt * 2e-3, centroid_absolute
    allowed_metadata = ["prf_hz", "pulse_width_s", "pulse_bandwidth_hz",
                        "fast_sample_rate_hz", "wavelength_m", "baseband_convention",
                        "echo_output_reference", "planned_target_extent_path_m",
                        "reference_time_utc", "intrapulse_motion_model", "compute_dtype"]
    audit = dict(created_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), case=case,
                 source=str(source), source_sha256=sha(source),
                 cache=str(cache), cache_sha256=sha(cache),
                 extraction_script_sha256=sha(__file__),
                 source_unchanged=(src_before == (source.stat().st_size, source.stat().st_mtime_ns)),
                 pulse_count=len(echo.iq), cpi_count=len(windows), full_axis_count=len(axis),
                 config=config, metadata={k: echo.metadata[k] for k in allowed_metadata},
                 normalization="CPI profile = sum_p Hann[p]^2 abs(full_aligned_iq[p,k])^2 / sum_p Hann[p]^2; multiply by count*sum(Hann^2) for original total_power",
                 binning="258 bins = left full-support tail + 256 equal acquisition-extent bins + right full-support tail; no signal-driven selection or normalization",
                 pulse_bin_normalization="sum of abs(full_aligned_iq)^2 in each fixed bin, no temporal averaging",
                 max_binned_power_conservation_relative=max_bin_sum_relative,
                 max_total_power_cache_relative=total_relative,
                 max_range_centroid_cache_absolute_s=centroid_absolute,
                 elapsed_s=time.perf_counter() - start,
                 source_hashes={name: sha(ROOT / name) for name in [
                     "inversion/src/inversion.py", "inversion/src/radar_signal.py",
                     "inversion/src/dataset.py"]})
    assert audit["source_unchanged"]
    np.savez_compressed(
        OUT / (case + "_full_power.npz"),
        range_power=profiles, range_delay_s=axis,
        bin_power=binned, inner_bin_edges_s=inner_edges, range_bin_label=labels,
        pulse_bin_power=pulse_binned, cpi_times_s=cpi_times,
        cpi_weighted_times_s=cpi_weighted_times, cpi_run_id=cpi_runs,
        cpi_windows=windows, cpi_hann_squared=weights,
        cpi_original_power_scale=norm, pulse_times_s=echo.scatter_elapsed_s,
        pulse_receive_times_s=echo.elapsed_s, pulse_emit_times_s=echo.emit_elapsed_s,
        pulse_run_id=echo.run_id, pulse_coherence_id=echo.coherence_id,
        tx_los_icrs=echo.tx_los_icrs, rx_los_icrs=echo.rx_los_icrs,
        tx_range_m=echo.tx_range_m, rx_range_m=echo.rx_range_m,
        row_start_sample=echo.row_start_sample,
        row_fast_time_offset_s=echo.row_fast_time_offset_s,
        metadata_json=json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False))
    (OUT / (case + "_manifest.json")).write_text(json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    echo.close()
    obs.close()
    print(case, "DONE", "cache total relative", total_relative, "centroid diff", centroid_absolute, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True)
    for case in sys.argv[1:] or ["400m", "70m"]:
        one_case(case)

"""Known-pole spherical response regression of all fixed range-power bins.

No shape or spin-period truth is read. All channel directions are kept by SVD.
Common ridge strength and degree selected by whole-profile leave-one-Run-out loss.
"""
import os
for name in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS"):
    os.environ[name] = "1"
from pathlib import Path
import json
import time
import sys
import hashlib
import numpy as np
from scipy.special import lpmv, gammaln
from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
POWER = OUT.parent
GEOMETRY = POWER.parent / "geometry"
ALPHAS = np.array([1e-8, 1e-5, 1e-3, .1, 10.])


def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(8 * 1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def run(tag):
    source = POWER / f"{tag}_full_power.npz"
    geometry_source = GEOMETRY / f"{tag}_inputs.npz"
    with np.load(source) as data, np.load(geometry_source) as geo:
        ids = data["cpi_run_id"]
        groups = np.unique(ids)
        assert np.array_equal(ids, geo["runs"])
        assert np.allclose(data["cpi_times_s"], geo["times"], rtol=0, atol=1e-9)
        t = np.array([data["cpi_times_s"][ids == group].mean() for group in groups])
        z = np.array([geo["z"][ids == group].mean() for group in groups])
        ph = np.array([geo["phase"][ids == group].mean() for group in groups])
        y_original = np.array([data["bin_power"][ids == group].mean(0) for group in groups])
    t -= t.mean()
    y_centered = y_original - y_original.mean(0)
    scale = np.sqrt(np.mean(y_centered ** 2))
    y_centered /= scale
    uy, sy, vy = np.linalg.svd(y_centered, full_matrices=False)
    y = uy * sy[None, :]
    gram_relative_error = float(np.max(np.abs(y @ y.T - y_centered @ y_centered.T)) /
                                np.max(np.abs(y_centered @ y_centered.T)))
    assert gram_relative_error < 1e-13
    # Retain original mean-square scale despite orthogonal channel compression.
    channel_count = y_original.shape[1]
    fs = np.linspace(1 / (14400 if tag == "70m" else 28800), 1 / 1800,
                     4000 if tag == "70m" else 8000)
    results = []
    report = dict(description="Whole fixed range-power profile spherical response; known pole 105/-66 degrees; mean of 5 CPIs per Run; all 258 bins including full support tails; one global matrix scale; all-rank output SVD; common alpha across all bins; degree and alpha chosen solely by full-profile leave-one-Run-out squared prediction loss.",
                  source=str(source), source_sha256=sha(source),
                  geometry_source=str(geometry_source), geometry_source_sha256=sha(geometry_source),
                  script_sha256=sha(__file__), run_count=len(t), original_channel_count=channel_count,
                  retained_svd_columns=y.shape[1], gram_relative_error=gram_relative_error,
                  global_scale=float(scale), alphas=ALPHAS.tolist(),
                  grid_min_frequency_hz=float(fs[0]), grid_max_frequency_hz=float(fs[-1]),
                  grid_count=len(fs), results=results)
    for L in [1, 2, 3, 4, 6]:
        terms = []
        for l in range(1, L + 1):
            for m in range(l + 1):
                norm = np.sqrt((2 * l + 1) * np.exp(gammaln(l-m+1) - gammaln(l+m+1)))
                amp = norm * lpmv(m, l, z) / (l * (l + 1))
                terms.append((m, False, amp))
                if m:
                    terms.append((m, True, amp))

        def design(f):
            angle = 2 * np.pi * f * t + ph
            return np.column_stack([
                amp * (np.sin(m * angle) if sine else np.cos(m * angle))
                for m, sine, amp in terms])

        def cv(f, alpha_index=None):
            X = design(f)
            X -= X.mean(0)
            U, s, vh = np.linalg.svd(X, full_matrices=False)
            coeff = U.T @ y
            aa = ALPHAS if alpha_index is None else ALPHAS[alpha_index:alpha_index+1]
            filters = s[None, :] ** 2 / (s[None, :] ** 2 + aa[:, None])
            fits = (U[None, :, :] * filters[:, None, :]) @ coeff
            leverage = 1 / len(y) + filters @ (U * U).T
            residual = (y[None, :, :] - fits) / (1 - leverage[:, :, None])
            loss = np.sum(residual ** 2, axis=(1, 2)) / (len(y) * channel_count)
            return loss if alpha_index is None else float(loss[0])

        # Independently fit held-out rows for one fixed design and alpha.
        # This detects leakage/centering/hat-matrix mistakes, not merely repeat math.
        f_check = float(fs[len(fs) // 3])
        X_check = design(f_check)
        held_losses = []
        alpha_check = 2
        for held in range(len(y)):
            mask = np.arange(len(y)) != held
            mean_x = X_check[mask].mean(0)
            mean_y = y[mask].mean(0)
            xt = X_check[mask] - mean_x
            yt = y[mask] - mean_y
            beta = np.linalg.lstsq(
                np.vstack((xt, np.sqrt(ALPHAS[alpha_check]) * np.eye(xt.shape[1]))),
                np.vstack((yt, np.zeros((xt.shape[1], yt.shape[1])))), rcond=None)[0]
            residual = y[held] - mean_y - (X_check[held] - mean_x) @ beta
            held_losses.append(np.sum(residual ** 2) / channel_count)
        loo_reference_error = float(abs(np.mean(held_losses) - cv(f_check, alpha_check)))
        assert loo_reference_error < 1e-8
        started = time.perf_counter()
        curves = np.array([cv(f) for f in fs])
        candidates = []
        counts = []
        for ai in range(len(ALPHAS)):
            curve = curves[:, ai]
            ix = np.r_[0, np.where((curve[1:-1] < curve[:-2]) &
                                   (curve[1:-1] < curve[2:]))[0] + 1, len(fs)-1]
            counts.append(len(ix))
            for j in ix:
                lo, hi = fs[max(0, j-1)], fs[min(len(fs)-1, j+1)]
                opt = minimize_scalar(lambda f: cv(f, ai), bounds=(lo, hi),
                                      method="bounded", options={"xatol": 1e-14})
                value, f = min((float(opt.fun), float(opt.x)), (float(curve[j]), float(fs[j])))
                candidates.append(dict(period_s=float(1/f), frequency_hz=f,
                                       cv_mean=value, alpha=float(ALPHAS[ai])))
        candidates.sort(key=lambda row: row["cv_mean"])
        result = dict(degree=L, basis_terms=len(terms),
                      loo_bruteforce_absolute_error=loo_reference_error,
                      refined_minima_per_alpha=counts,
                      elapsed_s=time.perf_counter()-started,
                      best_per_alpha=[min((r for r in candidates if r["alpha"] == float(a)),
                                          key=lambda r: r["cv_mean"]) for a in ALPHAS],
                      top20=candidates[:20])
        results.append(result)
        report["selected"] = min([dict(r["top20"][0], degree=r["degree"]) for r in results],
                                 key=lambda r: r["cv_mean"])
        np.savez_compressed(OUT / f"{tag}_degree{L}_curve.npz",
                            frequency_hz=fs, alphas=ALPHAS, loo_loss=curves)
        (OUT / f"{tag}_sphere_profiles.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print(tag, L, result["top20"][0], "elapsed_s", result["elapsed_s"], flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    run(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "400m")

"""Paired cache evaluation under an explicitly bounded numerical protocol.

All frequencies in 4x and 8x original grids. At each H/trial, refine the three
best local grid minima plus both endpoints; retain original grid scores.
This is NOT continuous global certification or refinement of every local
minimum. No period-truth neighborhood is used. Identical H and pooling rules
are frozen before noise results.
"""
from noise_mean_cv import *

def dense(case,device="cuda:0"):
 t,g,w,_,off,cfg=read_case(case,aggregate=False)
 off=off if cfg["los_phase_compensation"] else np.zeros_like(t)
 cache=ROOT/CASES[case][1]
 design=np.load(cache/"design.npz")
 data=np.load(cache/"features.npy",mmap_mode="r")
 snrs=[0.,10.,20.,30.]
 si=[int(np.flatnonzero(design["snr_db"]==v)[0]) for v in snrs]
 ys=np.asarray(data[:,si]).transpose(1,0,2,3).reshape(-1,len(t),5)
 identities=[{"snr_db":s,"replicate":i} for s in snrs for i in range(len(data))]
 count=(cfg["period_grid_size"]-1)*8+1
 dense_grid=np.sort(1/np.linspace(1/cfg["period_max_s"],1/cfg["period_min_s"],count))
 scorer=BatchMeanCV(t,g,w,ys,off,device=device)
 result={"case":case,"utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"identities":identities,
         "rule":"native500; mean normalized CV and sum positive CV skill squared; H in 1,2,4,8",
         "numerical_protocol":"full 4x/8x nested frequency grids; refine top3 local grid minima+both endpoints; retain grid candidates; NOT all minima refinement or continuous global certification",
         "script_sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
         "accelerator_sha256":hashlib.sha256((OUT/"noise_mean_cv.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
         "harmonics":[]}
 outfile=OUT/f"{case}_noise_dense.json"
 for h in HYPOTHESES:
  started=time.perf_counter()
  channels,cond=scorer.grid(dense_grid,h,details=True)
  pooled={"mean":channels.mean(axis=2),"positive_skill_squared":-np.sum(np.maximum(0,1-channels)**2,axis=2)}
  del channels
  record={"h":h,"max_design_condition":cond,"grid_seconds":time.perf_counter()-started,"resolutions":{}}
  print(case,h,"grid8x seconds",record["grid_seconds"],flush=True)
  for factor,stride in [(4,2),(8,1)]:
   grid=dense_grid[::stride]
   outcomes={}
   for pool,values8 in pooled.items():
    values=values8[::stride]
    rows=scorer.refine(grid,values,h,pool=pool,topk=3)
    checks=[]
    for j in [0,100,200,300,399]:
     ev=MeanCV(t,g,w,ys[j],off)
     cpuch=ev.evaluate(rows[j]["period_s"],h,details=True)
     expected=(cpuch.mean() if pool=="mean" else -np.sum(np.maximum(0,1-cpuch)**2))
     diff=abs(expected-rows[j]["score"])
     assert diff<1e-9,(h,factor,pool,j,diff)
     checks.append({"trial":j,"score_difference":float(diff)})
    outcomes[pool]={"winners":rows,"cpu_checks":checks}
    print(case,h,factor,pool,"elapsed",time.perf_counter()-started,flush=True)
   record["resolutions"][str(factor)]=outcomes
  record["wall_seconds"]=time.perf_counter()-started
  result["harmonics"].append(record)
  outfile.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
 result["selected"]={}
 for factor in ["4","8"]:
  result["selected"][factor]={pool:[
   min([r["resolutions"][factor][pool]["winners"][i] for r in result["harmonics"]],
       key=lambda v:(v["score"],v["h"])) for i in range(len(ys))]
   for pool in pooled}
 result["resolution_comparison"]={}
 for pool in pooled:
  a=result["selected"]["4"][pool];b=result["selected"]["8"][pool]
  dp=np.array([abs(x["period_s"]-y["period_s"]) for x,y in zip(a,b)])
  dh=np.array([x["h"]!=y["h"] for x,y in zip(a,b)])
  result["resolution_comparison"][pool]={"max_period_difference_s":float(dp.max()),

"""Independent final selected-score and statistics audit; no frequency search."""
import os
for key in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS"):
    os.environ[key] = "1"
import sys
import json
import csv
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import numpy as np
from independent_review import Independent, read_case, CASES, ROOT

OUT = Path(__file__).parent
WORK = OUT.parent
SNRS = [0., 10., 20., 30.]
POOLS = ["mean", "positive_skill_squared"]


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def summarize(periods, truth, old=None):
    p = np.asarray(periods, dtype=float)
    error = (p/truth-1)*100
    n = len(p)
    result = {"n": n, "bias_s": float(np.mean(p-truth)), "sd_s": float(p.std(ddof=1)),
        "rmse_pct": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(error**2))), "median_abs_pct": float(np.median(abs(error))),
        "max_abs_pct": float(np.max(abs(error))), "within_0p1_pct": int(np.sum(abs(error) <= .1)),
        "within_1_pct": int(np.sum(abs(error) <= 1.)), "over_10_pct_count": int(np.sum(abs(error) > 10.))}
    for tolerance, name in [(.1, "0p1"), (1., "1")]:
        phat = float(np.mean(abs(error) <= tolerance))
        z = 1.959963984540054
        center = (phat+z*z/(2*n))/(1+z*z/n)
        radius = z*np.sqrt(phat*(1-phat)/n+z*z/(4*n*n))/(1+z*z/n)
        result[f"wilson95_within_{name}_pct"] = [float(max(0., center-radius)), float(min(1., center+radius))]
    if old is not None:
        old = np.asarray(old)
        result["paired_improved_count"] = int(np.sum(abs(p-truth) < abs(old-truth)))
        result["paired_worsened_count"] = int(np.sum(abs(p-truth) > abs(old-truth)))
    return result


def audit(case):
    destination = OUT/f"{case}_NOISE_REVIEW.json"
    if destination.exists():
        saved = json.loads(destination.read_text())
        assert sha(WORK/f"features/{case}_noise_dense.json") == saved["source_hashes"][f"tmp/ev5_precision_solution_20261020/features/{case}_noise_dense.json"]
        return saved
    source = WORK/f"features/{case}_noise_dense.json"
    actual = json.loads(source.read_text())
    assert set(actual["selected"]) == {"4", "8"}
    expected_identities = [(s, i) for s in SNRS for i in range(100)]
    identities = [(row["snr_db"], row["replicate"]) for row in actual["identities"]]
    assert identities == expected_identities
    assert sorted(h["h"] for h in actual["harmonics"]) == [1, 2, 4, 8]
    for factor in ["4", "8"]:
        assert set(actual["selected"][factor]) == set(POOLS)
        for pool in POOLS:
            assert len(actual["selected"][factor][pool]) == 400
            for i, winner in enumerate(actual["selected"][factor][pool]):
                assert winner["trial_index"] == i and winner["pool"] == pool
                by_h = [h["resolutions"][factor][pool]["winners"][i] for h in actual["harmonics"]]
                assert winner == min(by_h, key=lambda r: (r["score"], r["h"]))
    t, g, w, _, off, cfg = read_case(case, False)
    off = off if cfg["los_phase_compensation"] else np.zeros_like(t)
    cache = ROOT/CASES[case][1]
    design = np.load(cache/"design.npz")
    data = np.load(cache/"features.npy", mmap_mode="r")
    truth = {"70m": 10800., "400m": 13410.}[case]
    assert actual["reporting_truth_s"] == truth
    baseline_file = ROOT/f"docs/4.3/vs_4.2/experiments/data/2026-10-16_RECEIVER_SNR_EV5_{case.upper()}.csv"
    baseline = {}
    with baseline_file.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
        for row in csv.DictReader(f):
            key = (float(row["snr_db"]), int(row["trial"]))
            if key[0] not in SNRS:
                continue
            assert key not in baseline and row["status"] == "selected"
            p = float(row["period_s"])
            assert abs(float(row["relative_error"])-abs(p/truth-1)) < 1e-12
            baseline[key] = p
    assert set(baseline) == set(expected_identities)
    result = {"case": case, "started_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "scope": "Selected-point independent original-scale scalar CPU SVD for every input, both pools, both grid resolutions; no repeat of full frequency search. Independent trial alignment and aggregate statistics against frozen historical production CSV.",
        "n_inputs": len(identities), "n_selected_score_checks": 0, "selected_score_checks": [],
        "summaries": [], "resolution_comparison": {}, "source_hashes": {}}
    maxdiff = 0.
    for i, (snr, trial) in enumerate(identities):
        si = np.flatnonzero(design["snr_db"] == snr)
        assert len(si) == 1
        raw = np.array(data[trial, int(si[0])])
        ev = Independent(t, g, w, raw, off)
        for factor in ["4", "8"]:
            for pool in POOLS:
                row = actual["selected"][factor][pool][i]
                assert cfg["period_min_s"] <= row["period_s"] <= cfg["period_max_s"]
                skills, condition = ev.skill(row["period_s"], row["h"], True)
                score = float(np.mean(1-skills)) if pool == "mean" else -float(np.sum(np.maximum(0, skills)**2))
                diff = abs(score-row["score"])
                assert np.isfinite(score) and diff < 1e-9, (case, factor, pool, i, diff)
                maxdiff = max(maxdiff, diff)
                result["selected_score_checks"].append({"snr_db": snr, "trial": trial, "factor": factor,
                    "pool": pool, "h": row["h"], "period_s": row["period_s"],
                    "independent_score": score, "stored_score": row["score"],
                    "absolute_difference": diff, "max_design_condition": condition})
        if (i+1) % 100 == 0:
            print(case, "independent selected-score checks", 4*(i+1), "max_difference", maxdiff, flush=True)
    result["n_selected_score_checks"] = len(result["selected_score_checks"])
    result["max_selected_score_absolute_difference"] = maxdiff
    for snr in SNRS:
        old = [baseline[(snr, trial)] for trial in range(100)]
        result["summaries"].append({"pool": "production_h1_median", "snr_db": snr, **summarize(old, truth)})
        for factor in ["4", "8"]:
            for pool in POOLS:
                rows = [row for row, identity in zip(actual["selected"][factor][pool], identities) if identity[0] == snr]
                summary = summarize([row["period_s"] for row in rows], truth, old)
                summary["h_counts"] = {str(h): sum(row["h"] == h for row in rows) for h in [1, 2, 4, 8]}
                source_summary = next(r for r in actual["summary"] if r["factor"] == factor and r["pool"] == pool and r["snr_db"] == snr)
                mapping = {"bias_s": "bias_s", "rmse_pct": "rmse_percent", "median_abs_pct": "median_abs_percent",
                    "within_0p1_pct": "within_0p1_percent", "within_1_pct": "within_1_percent", "h_counts": "h_counts"}
                for key, other_key in mapping.items():
                    if key == "h_counts":
                        assert summary[key] == source_summary[other_key]
                    else:
                        assert abs(summary[key]-source_summary[other_key]) < 1e-10
                summary["worst5"] = [{"trial": i, "period_s": rows[i]["period_s"], "h": rows[i]["h"],
                    "signed_error_pct": (rows[i]["period_s"]/truth-1)*100} for i in sorted(range(100), key=lambda i: abs(rows[i]["period_s"]-truth), reverse=True)[:5]]
                result["summaries"].append({"factor": factor, "pool": pool, "snr_db": snr, **summary})
    for pool in POOLS:
        four, eight = actual["selected"]["4"][pool], actual["selected"]["8"][pool]
        dp = np.array([abs(a["period_s"]-b["period_s"]) for a, b in zip(four, eight)])
        dh = np.array([a["h"] != b["h"] for a, b in zip(four, eight)])
        got = {"max_period_difference_s": float(dp.max()), "period_difference_over_0p001s_count": int(np.sum(dp > .001)),
            "different_h_count": int(dh.sum()), "different_0p1_success_count": int(sum((abs(a["period_s"]/truth-1) <= .001) != (abs(b["period_s"]/truth-1) <= .001) for a, b in zip(four, eight))),
            "different_rows": [{"snr_db": identities[i][0], "trial": identities[i][1], "four": four[i], "eight": eight[i]} for i in np.flatnonzero((dp > .001) | dh)]}
        for key in ["max_period_difference_s", "period_difference_over_0p001s_count", "different_h_count"]:
            assert got[key] == actual["resolution_comparison"][pool][key]
        result["resolution_comparison"][pool] = got
    for p in [source, cache/"features.npy", cache/"design.npz", baseline_file, Path(__file__), OUT/"independent_review.py"]:
        result["source_hashes"][p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()] = sha(p)
    result["completed_utc"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print("SAVED", destination, flush=True)
    return result


def main():
    cases = sys.argv[1:] or ["70m", "400m"]
    for case in cases:
        audit(case)
    sources = [OUT/f"{case}_NOISE_REVIEW.json" for case in ["70m", "400m"]]
    final = OUT/"FINAL_NOISE_REVIEW.json"
    if all(p.exists() for p in sources) and not final.exists():
        rows = [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in sources]
        for case, row in zip(["70m", "400m"], rows):
            assert sha(WORK/f"features/{case}_noise_dense.json") == row["source_hashes"][f"tmp/ev5_precision_solution_20261020/features/{case}_noise_dense.json"]
        result = {"completed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "environment": "Conda pytorch; CPU float64; BLAS/OMP/MKL one thread; no CUDA",
            "n_original_inputs": sum(r["n_inputs"] for r in rows),
            "n_independent_selected_score_checks": sum(r["n_selected_score_checks"] for r in rows),
            "max_score_absolute_difference": max(r["max_selected_score_absolute_difference"] for r in rows),
            "cases": rows,
            "limits": "Cached same-physical-scene comparisons; grid-resolution consistency is not continuous global certification; selected-score rechecks do not repeat frequency searches; Wilson intervals describe conditional simulation successes and do not calibrate systematic physical uncertainty."}
        final.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print("SAVED", final, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Independent CPU audit; only writes its own evidence, never source inputs."""
import os
for key in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS"):
    os.environ[key] = "1"
os.environ["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"] = "1"
import json
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import numpy as np
from scipy import optimize
from scipy.special import lpmv, gammaln
from independent_review import Independent, SkillSquared, read_case, CASES, scan, ROOT
from inversion.src.joint_period import select_predictive_period

OUT = Path(__file__).parent
WORK = OUT.parent


def audit_a(case):
    t, g, w, y, off, cfg = read_case(case, aggregate=False)
    off = off if cfg["los_phase_compensation"] else np.zeros_like(t)
    run, cache = CASES[case]
    d = np.load(ROOT / cache / "design.npz")
    raw = np.load(ROOT / cache / "clean_features.npy")
    obs = np.load(ROOT / run / "inversion/period_observables.npz")["value"]
    saved = json.loads((WORK / f"features/{case}_native500_skill2.json").read_text())
    ev = Independent(t, g, w, raw, off)
    original_ev = SkillSquared(t, g, w, y, off)
    sums = np.array([w[g == k].sum() for k in np.unique(g)])
    result = {
        "case": case, "n_cpi": len(t), "n_runs": len(sums),
        "run_counts": np.unique(np.unique(g, return_counts=True)[1]).tolist(),
        "original_cpi_weights": np.unique(w).tolist(),
        "run_weight_sum_min_max": [float(sums.min()), float(sums.max())],
        "cache_weight_max_difference": float(np.max(abs(w-d["weights"]))),
        "cache_time_max_difference": float(np.max(abs(t-(d["times"]-min(d["times"]))))),
        "cache_groups_equal": bool(np.array_equal(g, d["runs"])),
        "cache_los_max_difference": float(np.max(abs(off-d["phase_offset"]))) if "phase_offset" in d else float(max(abs(off))),
        "original_inversion_axis": {k: cfg[k] for k in ["los_phase_compensation", "spin_axis_ra_deg", "spin_axis_dec_deg", "phase_period_convention"] if k in cfg},
        "source_feature_max_scaled_difference": (np.max(abs(raw-obs), axis=0)/np.max(abs(raw), axis=0)).tolist(),
        "winner_score_checks": [], "dense_harmonics": [],
    }
    for row in saved["harmonics"]:
        p, h = row["candidates"][0]["period_s"], row["h"]
        sk, cond = ev.skill(p, h, True)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(1-sk, original_ev.evaluate(p, h, details=True), rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-10)
        result["winner_score_checks"].append({"h": h, "period_s": p,
            "score_difference": ev.objective(p, h)-row["candidates"][0]["score"],
            "max_design_condition": cond, "skills": sk.tolist()})
    grid = np.sort(1/np.linspace(1/cfg["period_max_s"], 1/cfg["period_min_s"], cfg["period_grid_size"]))
    names = [f"channel{i}" for i in range(5)]
    baseline = select_predictive_period(t, dict(zip(names, raw.T)), g,
        {n: {"grid_periods_s": grid} for n in names}, weights=w, phase_offset=off,
        min_period=cfg["period_min_s"], max_period=cfg["period_max_s"])
    saved_baseline = json.loads((ROOT / run / "inversion/period_selection.json").read_text())
    result["production_baseline"] = {"recomputed_period_s": baseline["period_s"],
        "saved_period_s": saved_baseline["period_s"], "score": baseline["score"]}
    sel = saved["selected"]
    obs_ev = Independent(t, g, w, obs, off)
    opt = optimize.minimize_scalar(lambda p: obs_ev.objective(p, sel["h"]),
        bounds=(sel["period_s"]-5, sel["period_s"]+5), method="bounded", options={"xatol": 1e-8})
    result["original_value_local_comparison"] = {"period_s": float(opt.x),
        "difference_from_cache_s": float(opt.x-sel["period_s"]),
        "scope": "Only a local source-roundoff comparison; global search uses frozen clean_features."}
    grid = np.sort(1/np.linspace(1/cfg["period_max_s"], 1/cfg["period_min_s"], 2*cfg["period_grid_size"]-1))
    for h in [1, 2, 4, 8]:
        row = scan(ev, grid, h)
        old = next(r["candidates"][0] for r in saved["harmonics"] if r["h"] == h)
        row["difference_from_saved_period_s"] = row["winner"]["period_s"]-old["period_s"]
        row["difference_from_saved_score"] = row["winner"]["score"]-old["score"]
        result["dense_harmonics"].append(row)
        print(case, h, row["winner"], flush=True)
    result["selected"] = min(result["dense_harmonics"], key=lambda r: (r["winner"]["score"], r["h"]))
    return result


def audit_b(case):
    d = np.load(WORK / f"geometry/{case}_inputs.npz")
    rows = json.loads((WORK / f"geometry/{case}_full500_all_train.json").read_text())["results"]
    win = min(rows, key=lambda r: r["top10"][0]["cv_mean"])
    saved, degree = win["top10"][0], win["degree"]
    t = d["times"]-d["times"].mean()
    z, angle = d["z"], 2*np.pi*t/saved["period_s"]+d["phase"]
    raw = d["features"]
    y = (raw-raw.mean(0))/raw.std(0)
    alphas = np.array([1e-8, 1e-5, 1e-3, .1, 10.])
    terms = []
    for ell in range(1, degree+1):
        for m in range(ell+1):
            amp = np.sqrt((2*ell+1)*np.exp(gammaln(ell-m+1)-gammaln(ell+m+1)))*lpmv(m, ell, z)/(ell*(ell+1))
            terms.append(amp*np.cos(m*angle))
            if m:
                terms.append(amp*np.sin(m*angle))
    x = np.column_stack(terms)
    error = np.zeros((5, 5))
    for group in np.unique(d["runs"]):
        keep = d["runs"] != group
        test = ~keep
        mx, my = x[keep].mean(0), y[keep].mean(0)
        u, s, vh = np.linalg.svd(x[keep]-mx, full_matrices=False)
        rhs = u.T@(y[keep]-my)
        for ai, alpha in enumerate(alphas):
            beta = vh.T@((s/(s*s+alpha))[:, None]*rhs)
            residual = y[test]-my-(x[test]-mx)@beta
            error[ai] += np.sum((residual/y[keep].std(0))**2, axis=0)/len(y)
    return {"case": case, "degree": degree, "period_s": saved["period_s"],
        "held_out_runs_explicitly_refit": len(np.unique(d["runs"])),
        "alphas_per_run": alphas.tolist(), "score": float(error.min(0).mean()),
        "saved_score": saved["cv_mean"], "score_difference": float(error.min(0).mean()-saved["cv_mean"]),
        "alpha_by_feature": alphas[error.argmin(0)].tolist(),
        "per_channel_score_difference": (error.min(0)-saved["per_feature_min_cv"]).tolist(),
        "contiguous_100x5_run_layout": bool(np.array_equal(d["runs"].reshape(100, 5), np.repeat(np.unique(d["runs"])[:, None], 5, axis=1))),
        "scope": "All 100 Run deletions and 5 alphas at selected f,L; not a repeat of the whole spherical frequency/degree search."}


def main():
    output = OUT / "FINAL_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.json"
    if output.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("Refuse to overwrite completed independent evidence")
    result = {"started_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "environment": "Conda pytorch; CPU float64; BLAS/OMP/MKL one thread; no CUDA",
        "scope": "Independent original-scale scalar SVD A scoring, doubled full-domain A search, original selector, and all-Run explicit B refits. No independent unseen physical scenes.",
        "a": [], "b": [], "input_hashes": {}}
    for case in ["70m", "400m"]:
        result["a"].append(audit_a(case))
        result["b"].append(audit_b(case))
        run, cache = CASES[case]
        for path in [ROOT/cache/"clean_features.npy", ROOT/cache/"design.npz",
                     ROOT/run/"inversion/period_observables.npz", ROOT/run/"inversion/period_selection.json",
                     WORK/f"geometry/{case}_inputs.npz", WORK/f"geometry/{case}_full500_all_train.json",
                     WORK/f"features/{case}_native500_skill2.json"]:
            result["input_hashes"][path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    for path in [Path(__file__), OUT/"independent_review.py"]:

"""Read-only independent scalar SVD audit of the frozen feature experiment."""
import os
for key in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS"):
    os.environ[key] = "1"
import sys
import json
import time
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import numpy as np
from scipy import optimize, signal

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tmp/ev5_precision_solution_20261020/features"))
from scripts.monte_carlo_period import FixedPredictiveSearch
from search_features import read_case, CASES, NAMES
from verify_skill2 import SkillSquared
OUT = Path(__file__).parent

class Independent:
    def __init__(self, t, g, w, raw, off):
        self.t = t - min(t)
        self.off = off
        self.w = np.asarray(w, dtype=float).copy()
        for k in np.unique(g):
            self.w[g == k] /= sum(self.w[g == k])
        # A scale-only change keeps raw means for independent baseline centering.
        self.y = raw / np.max(abs(raw), axis=0)
        ordered = sorted(np.unique(g), key=lambda k: np.mean(t[g == k]))
        labels = np.zeros(len(g), dtype=int)
        for i, k in enumerate(ordered):
            labels[g == k] = i % 5
        self.folds = [(labels != k, labels == k) for k in range(5)]
        self.den = np.zeros(raw.shape[1])
        for train, test in self.folds:
            center = np.sum(self.w[train, None] * self.y[train], axis=0) / sum(self.w[train])
            self.den += np.sum(self.w[test, None] * (self.y[test] - center) ** 2, axis=0)
        assert np.all(self.den > 0)

    def skill(self, p, h, return_condition=False):
        phase = 2 * np.pi * self.t / p + self.off
        x = np.empty((len(self.t), 2*h+1))
        x[:, 0] = 1
        x[:, 1::2] = np.cos(phase[:, None] * np.arange(1, h+1))
        x[:, 2::2] = np.sin(phase[:, None] * np.arange(1, h+1))
        num = np.zeros(self.y.shape[1])
        conds = []
        for train, test in self.folds:
            root = np.sqrt(self.w[train])
            beta, _, rank, sv = np.linalg.lstsq(x[train] * root[:, None], self.y[train] * root[:, None], rcond=None)
            assert rank == x.shape[1]
            conds.append(float(sv[0] / sv[-1]))
            num += np.sum(self.w[test, None] * (self.y[test] - x[test] @ beta) ** 2, axis=0)
        skill = 1 - num/self.den
        return (skill, max(conds)) if return_condition else skill

    def objective(self, p, h):
        return -float(np.sum(np.clip(self.skill(p, h), 0, None)**2))

def scan(ev, grid, h):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    values = np.array([ev.objective(p, h) for p in grid])
    inds = np.unique(np.r_[0, signal.find_peaks(-values)[0], len(grid)-1])
    rows = []
    for i in inds:
        lo, hi = grid[max(i-1, 0)], grid[min(i+1, len(grid)-1)]
        fit = optimize.minimize_scalar(lambda p: ev.objective(p, h), bounds=(lo, hi), method="bounded", options={"xatol": 1e-7})
        p, q = (float(fit.x), float(fit.fun)) if fit.success and fit.fun < values[i] else (float(grid[i]), float(values[i]))
        rows.append({"period_s": p, "score": q, "grid_index": int(i)})
    rows.sort(key=lambda a: (a["score"], a["period_s"]))
    return {"h": h, "grid_points": len(grid), "local_minima_and_endpoints": len(inds),
            "winner": rows[0], "top5": rows[:5], "wall_seconds": time.perf_counter()-start}

def audit(case):
    t, g, w, y, off, cfg = read_case(case, aggregate=False)
    run, cache_rel = CASES[case]
    cache = ROOT / cache_rel
    raw = np.load(cache / "clean_features.npy")
    des = np.load(cache / "design.npz")
    original = json.loads((ROOT / f"tmp/ev5_precision_solution_20261020/features/{case}_native500_skill2.json").read_text())
    off = off if cfg["los_phase_compensation"] else np.zeros_like(t)
    ev = Independent(t, g, w, raw, off)
    original_ev = SkillSquared(t, g, w, y, off)
    sums = np.array([sum(w[g == k]) for k in np.unique(g)])
    result = {"case": case, "utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "n_cpi": len(t), "n_runs": len(sums),
              "run_weight_sum_min": float(sums.min()), "run_weight_sum_max": float(sums.max()),
              "config": cfg, "checks": {}, "original_harmonics": [], "doubled_harmonics": []}
    result["checks"]["cache_times_match"] = bool(np.allclose(t, des["times"]-min(des["times"]), atol=0, rtol=0))
    result["checks"]["cache_groups_match"] = bool(np.array_equal(g, des["runs"]))
    result["checks"]["cache_weights_max_difference"] = float(np.max(abs(w-des["weights"])))
    result["checks"]["cache_phase_max_difference"] = float(np.max(abs(off-des["phase_offset"]))) if "phase_offset" in des else float(max(abs(off)))
    for record in original["harmonics"]:
        h = record["h"]
        p = record["candidates"][0]["period_s"]
        sk, condition = ev.skill(p, h, True)
        q = ev.objective(p, h)
        contrib = np.clip(sk, 0, None)**2
        result["original_harmonics"].append({"h": h, "period_s": p, "score_difference": q-record["candidates"][0]["score"],
            "max_design_condition": condition, "channels": [{"name": n, "skill": float(s), "positive_square": float(c),
                "fraction_of_J": float(c/sum(contrib))} for n, s, c in zip(NAMES, sk, contrib)]})
        np.testing.assert_allclose(1-sk, original_ev.evaluate(p, h, details=True), rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-10)
    result["checks"]["independent_vs_original_at_winners"] = "passed rtol=atol=1e-10"
    # Exact current production selector, rather than a truth-conditioned basin.
    baseline = FixedPredictiveSearch(des["times"], des["runs"], des["weights"],
                                    cfg["period_min_s"], cfg["period_max_s"], cfg["period_grid_size"],
                                    des["phase_offset"] if "phase_offset" in des else None)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    bp = baseline.production(raw)
    result["production_baseline"] = {k: bp[k] for k in ("period_s", "score", "status", "candidates", "diagnostics")}
    result["production_baseline_seconds"] = time.perf_counter()-start
    (OUT/f"{case}_independent.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(case, "baseline", bp["period_s"], "weight range", sums.min(), sums.max(), flush=True)
    grid = np.sort(1/np.linspace(1/cfg["period_max_s"], 1/cfg["period_min_s"], 2*cfg["period_grid_size"]-1))
    for h in (1, 2, 4, 8):
        row = scan(ev, grid, h)
        old = next(r["candidates"][0] for r in original["harmonics"] if r["h"] == h)
        row["difference_from_original_s"] = row["winner"]["period_s"]-old["period_s"]
        row["score_difference_from_original"] = row["winner"]["score"]-old["score"]
        result["doubled_harmonics"].append(row)
        (OUT/f"{case}_independent.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print(case, h, row["winner"], "delta_s", row["difference_from_original_s"], "seconds", row["wall_seconds"], flush=True)
    result["input_hashes"] = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for p in (cache/"clean_features.npy", cache/"design.npz", ROOT/run/"inversion/period_observables.npz")}
    result["review_script_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    result["selected"] = min(result["doubled_harmonics"], key=lambda a: (a["winner"]["score"], a["h"]))
    (OUT/f"{case}_independent.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for c in sys.argv[1:] or ("70m", "400m"):
        audit(c)
